thresholds.rule: high = lowest t with precision(p>=t)>=0.95; low = highest t with recall(p>=t)>=0.98, both on out-of-fold stacker probabilities
thresholds.tiers: retake: p>=high; ambiguous: low<=p<high; unlikely: p<low
thresholds.t_amb_rule: ambiguous pairs (low <= stacker p < high) are resolved by the cross-encoder: retake if prob_mean >= t_amb; t_amb maximises F1 among the out-of-fold pairs whose out-of-fold stacker probability lies in that band

fallback.note: Stage 2 formula 0.5*semantic+0.3*lexical+0.2*containment with the old rules, used when model files are missing

models.seed_averaging: mean of sigmoid(logit) over the 3 seeds (prob_mean), then logit(clip(prob_mean))

cross_encoder_hyperparameters.input: (text_a, text_b) raw text, earlier unit first

unsure_band.method: t_lo = highest value (floored to 8 decimals) such that at most 3% of the true retakes among the ambiguous-band pairs have cross-encoder prob <= t_lo; t_hi = t_amb. Pairs with t_lo < ce < t_hi are escalated to the user. Fitted on out-of-fold scores.
